gaps.detail: world/city.js geometry changed. The minimap reads CITY.ROADS for streets, and it also hardcodes MINI bounds, spanFar, the airport dot, and the soccer dome. Neon World minimap (split-map) (`split-map`, PR #37) has to confirm those against the new map.

gaps.summary: Moved city can restore a Resume save inside a wall
gaps.detail: Building or road coordinates changed and this branch has no mapStamp + spotClear resume guard. Neon World Save & Resume (`cursor/world-save-resume-b8a9`, PR #79) has to reject a saved spot that fails CITY.probe and snap to the district or road anchor.

notes: Traffic lanes rebuild from CITY.ROADS on the next page load. They do not refresh mid-session (no roadsSig). That is enough for a full reload and not enough for builder-mode road edits.
Hot Drop still uses CITY.ROADS, so the beacon follows the new streets without a second coordinate list.
Both world pages must gain any new script together. Adult index.html stays untouched.
